name: sdlc-pipeline
description: Automated software development lifecycle — intake, research, PRD and stories, UX design and audit, a versioned Figma design implementers and QA build against, architecture with ADRs, a test plan specified before the code, implementation, root-cause debugging, code review, functional and UI QA, cycling until every gate passes. Agents coordinate through a durable filesystem workspace with an append-only history.
